game_title: Call Stack Tower – Chimney Roofs Rush
game_concept: A action puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Chimney Roofs, snowy chimney rooftops: the sled courier must handle blizzard sprites while practicing functions. Core idea – Call Stack Tower: Trace nested function calls as stacked blocks and unwind them in order.
theme: Snowy Hold – Chimney Roofs: snowy chimney rooftops
core_gameplay_loop: In Chimney Roofs, repeat each round: Trace nested function calls as stacked blocks and unwind them in order. Each round, a new flint stones challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the stack_height value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 70 points of flint stones by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 70, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 1 (intro tier): Call Stack Tower
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
